notes.title: V1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone who has already tried out These Darker Tides, the reception has been great and so has the feedback!

Bug fixes:

 People were unlocking achievements for progressive tasks immediately, this has been fixed. I'm not sure if you already have the achievement if you get to keep it but at the very least your progress is stored in game so you won't have lost any progress towards the goal.
 The paper toss minigame now resets correctly between game modes
 At the end of the Ghost storymode the movespeed resets correctly if you want to have another go at the final day
 Fixed resetting interaction with the monitor after the end of the Mermaid game mode so you can jump right into playing a different mode without having to exit and restart the game.
 It is not slightly easier to get the alternate ending to the Mermaid story mode (only mode with 2 endings). However this doesn't affect your gameplay/ability to complete the game it's just some extra flair.

notes.title: Demo Updates - Hotfixes and Changes to Controls
notes.notes:
These Darker Tides now has a release date, March 7th 2025!

 - Added an in game manual that highlights the different parts of each camera and camera slot per game mode for reference in game.
 - Changed firing flares with "F" to the Space Bar.
 - Reduced time penalty on missing minigames windows.
 - Stopped mermaids from doubling up when attacking the top hatch
 - Fixed the wrong camera part showing as damaged on occasion

notes.title: Demo Updates - Balancing changes
notes.notes:
You had comments and we listened! After hours of playtesting we simply got too good at the game and kept upping the frequency and difficulty of the creature attacks as well as making the mini-games too unforgiving. Obviously this isn't the experience that everyone would want when playing the game for the first time so we've rolled back a lot of the difficulty so the game and ambience can actually be enjoyed over being a frantic click-fest.

 - Minigames have larger room for error now when clicking
 - Creatures attack less often to give time to perform other tasks but slowly ramp up over the 6-day shift
 - Alarm is now less grating, not as loud, and can be turned off in the settings menu
 - When replacing a cracked lens it now also removes the "Dirty" status if applied as it makes sense a new lens would be clean
 - Reduced the delay after hitting the launch flare button before it is active again from 5 seconds to 3
 - Updated tutorials with more descriptive text about actual steps required
